name: After § 107
title: REPORT on the situation of fundamental rights in the European Union in 2024 and 2025
part_text: 107a. Reaffirms the essential contribution of religious communities to social cohesion, democratic life and the promotion of solidarity and charitable action; stresses the need to clearly distinguish between the peaceful expression of religious belief and acts of violence or coercion; warns against the use of language that may associate, even indirectly, religious teachings or participation in public life with forms of extremism; calls for the full protection of freedom of religion or belief, both in the private and public spheres, in accordance with the Charter of Fundamental Rights of the European Union;
